_comment: Proposed answers for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge, derived from evidence in this repository. Only criteria backed by a file or setting are listed; everything else is left for the maintainers to answer. Format: https://github.com/ossf/best-practices-badge/blob/main/docs/bestpractices-json.md
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependencies are checked automatically for updates and known vulnerabilities, configured in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/blob/main/renovate.json
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are public, searchable, addressable by URL and need no proprietary client: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/issues
floss_license_justification: Released under GPL-2.0, an OSI-approved licence: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/blob/main/LICENSE
license_location_justification: The licence is in the repository root: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/blob/main/LICENSE
release_notes_justification: Human-readable release notes per version are kept in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md; it covers the latest release, v1.0.0.
repo_distributed_justification: The repository uses git, hosted at https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache
repo_public_justification: The source repository is public on GitHub: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache
repo_track_justification: Git records the author, date and change of every commit; the history is browsable at https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/commits/main
report_archive_justification: All reports and responses stay publicly searchable in the issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported through the GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/issues
sites_https_justification: The repository and its download URLs are served over HTTPS by GitHub: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache
static_analysis_justification: PHPStan runs in CI on every change: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_justification: The repository carries 42 PHPUnit test files under Tests/, run by CI as shown in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Every pull request runs the test suite in GitHub Actions: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
version_semver_justification: Releases follow Semantic Versioning, for example v1.0.0: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/tags
version_tags_justification: Every release is tagged in git: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/tags
version_unique_justification: Each release has its own version number, recorded as a git tag, for example v1.0.0: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/tags
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports go through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, which is enabled and described in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/blob/main/SECURITY.md: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The vulnerability reporting process is published in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-temporal-cache/blob/main/SECURITY.md
